shortDescription: According to Bloomberg, South Korea announced phased measures to calm markets amid rising volatility, including ensuring a stock stabilization fund is ready to respond when needed, top financial officials said after an emergency meeting on Sunday.

title: South Korea Plans Staged Steps to Steady Volatile Markets
